embedding.default.description: Deterministic text embeddings resolved through the local embedding model role.

candidates.reason: The resource owns the embedding model and its declared vector dimension.

detect.pii.default.description: Detect personally-identifiable information in text and return typed spans. Served by the local pii-detector resource (deterministic regex/checksum pass merged with an NER model). Local-only: PII scanning must not leave the host.

candidates.reason: The pii-detector resource owns the tiered PII model policy (pii.small default -> pii.default -> pii.large) and always runs the deterministic regex/checksum pass.

decide.fast.description: Typed choice/score/noul decisions from non-generative decision models: local Laya first, hosted Jev and Clef when their credentials are provisioned, and the classify.fast enum path for choice-only question sets.

candidates.reason: Local Laya answers in milliseconds on the GPU and keeps the state on the host.
Hosted TypeSafe Jev through Eden AI; skipped until vrooli/edenai is provisioned.
Hosted TypeSafe Jev direct; skipped until vrooli/typesafe is provisioned.
Hosted Cloudflare Clef-flash; skipped until vrooli/cloudflare-workers-ai is provisioned.
Last resort for choice-only questions: the enum-constrained LLM path, which returns labels without calibrated probabilities.

decide.accurate.description: Decisions that favour accuracy over latency: local Winnow-E4B when pulled, then hosted Jev and Clef, then local Laya, then the classify.fast enum path for choice-only question sets.

candidates.reason: Winnow-E4B is the most accurate open decision model; skipped until it is pulled (8 GB, ~9 GB VRAM for GPU).
Hosted TypeSafe Jev through Eden AI.
Hosted TypeSafe Jev direct.
Hosted Cloudflare Clef-flash.
Local Laya keeps decisions available when no accurate candidate can serve.
Last resort for choice-only questions through the enum-constrained LLM path.

decide.short.description: Decisions about short states (a message or a few lines, about 250 characters of evidence): the 512-token Coba models. Not for long digests: a state past the model's context returns context_overflow. Declared per label by callers that know their state is short, so the general tiers keep their order.

candidates.reason: Measured bake-off 2026-11-20 on operator-mood gold: best of the cleared-rights models up to 1.9 GiB on all three mood labels at the same warm latency as Laya (about 0.24 s for three questions). Clears no gate by itself.
Local Laya answers when Coba 400M cannot be admitted; measured below it on every mood label.

decide.short.accurate.description: Escalation for decide.short: a different, larger model re-asks the answers the first tier was unsure of. Same short-state limit.

candidates.reason: Measured bake-off 2026-11-20: the only measured cleared-rights model larger than Coba 400M (3.5 GiB, about 6 s warm for three questions); its gain over the 400M is within a few gold rows.
Local Laya keeps escalation available when Coba 1B cannot be admitted.

decide.candidates.description: Bake-off role: every local decision model under evaluation, reachable only by pinning one with pin_resource_role. A pinned request is answered by exactly that candidate or refused with its typed reason, never by another; locality, privacy and rights rules still apply. Production callers use decide.fast or decide.accurate, never this role.

candidates.reason: Laya router, the current decide.fast model: the baseline every candidate is measured against.
Winnow-E4B, the current decide.accurate model: the accuracy baseline.
Laya fine-tuned on the typed-decisions workflows (421M, 1024-token context).
Coba 400M, Ollaya's own Laya-network model distilled from pplx-decider.
Coba 1B, the most accurate Coba size.
Largha 150M, the smallest multilingual decision encoder under evaluation.
Decima-base-clean, a late-interaction scorer trained without non-commercial data.
Decima-agent, tuned for coding-agent decisions with an 8192-token state; rights unknown until the operator decides.
Decima-small, the fastest CPU model under evaluation; rights unknown until the operator decides.
ModernBERT-large zero-shot NLI baseline; rights unknown until the operator decides.
DeBERTa-v3-large zero-shot NLI baseline; rights unknown until the operator decides.
Perplexity pplx-decider-flash (Qwen3.5-4B), the strongest open decider under evaluation; GPU only.
Kev 4B (LoRA plus pointer head on Qwen3.5-4B-Base); GPU only.
Credence v1 E4B calibrated (Winnow refinement with validation-fitted temperature); GPU only, rights unknown until the operator decides.
The enum-constrained LLM path, as a no-probability baseline for choice questions.

classify.fast.description: Low-cost enum classification with a grammar-friendly local first candidate.

candidates.reason: Small local classification role; the enum grammar carries most of the constraint.
Hosted classification fallback when the local resource is unavailable.
Hosted OrcaRouter classification fallback when the local resource is unavailable and OpenRouter is not preferred.
Subscription-backed metered fallback when local and operator BYOK routes are unavailable.

extract.structured.description: Schema-constrained extraction. The incumbent remains active while the compact local lane is qualified on real caller schemas.

candidates.reason: Mid-size local generation role; the gateway validates every returned value locally.
Hosted structured-output fallback for schemas the local resource cannot reliably produce.
Hosted OrcaRouter structured-output fallback.
Subscription-backed metered structured-output fallback.

candidate.reason: LM4 compact extraction candidate; not dispatched until a real-caller comparison qualifies it.

device.geometry.byok.description: Explicit BYOK-only provider route for Device Studio geometry construction; no candidate fallback.

candidates.reason: The caller explicitly selected its owner-managed OpenRouter credential.

device.geometry.vrooli_credits.description: Explicit Vrooli-credits-only provider route for Device Studio geometry construction; no candidate fallback.

candidates.reason: The caller explicitly selected LPBS metered inference and credit accounting.

judge.default.description: Deterministic rubric evaluation with a local-first candidate and hosted fallback.

candidates.reason: Local judge keeps rubric decisions available without a network dependency.
Hosted structured-output fallback when the local judge is unavailable.
Hosted OrcaRouter structured-output judge fallback.
Subscription-backed metered judge fallback.

summarize.faithful.description: Compress source into a short summary while preserving its supported facts, numbers, dates, and attribution. The role routes to the resource-owned summary policy; callers remain responsible for validating task-specific fidelity.

candidates.reason: Resource-owned summarization policy; concrete model and fallback remain governed by resource policy.

candidate.reason: LM4 compact faithful-summary candidate; not dispatched until a real caller validates factual fidelity.

summarize.audio_tools.description: Compact local summaries for Audio Tools speech output. This application-scoped role uses Qwen3 1.7B; callers should preserve important facts and use a separately selected quality route for fact-dense content.

candidates.reason: Audio Tools owns this compact summary role; generic summarize.faithful remains governed by summarize.default.

summarize.audio_tools.quality.description: Fact-dense local summary alternative for Audio Tools using Qwen3.5 4B. Evidence is limited to one 300-word report; it is not broad qualification.

candidates.reason: Audio Tools quality alternative. The compact 1.7B default retained 14/22 facts on one 300-word report; preserve this option for fact-dense input.

ux.visual-critique.description: Inspect a served user interface screenshot and return only visible UX findings using the caller's declared schema.

candidates.reason: Keep UX screenshots on the local, resource-governed vision model; preserve the caller's finding schema.

locate.visual.description: Visual grounding that returns canonical target bounds and confidence without exposing provider coordinates.

candidates.reason: Local-first grounding keeps captured frames on the device and uses the measured vision model ladder.
Hosted multimodal grounding fallback for hosts without an available local vision rung.
Hosted OrcaRouter visual grounding fallback.
Subscription-backed metered visual grounding fallback.

device-control.plan.description: Bounded device-control planning over a typed capability and state world model; returns one declared step or a goal-complete verdict.

candidates.reason: Use Ollama's existing local generation role with gateway schema validation; the dedicated resource extraction role is not yet available.
Hosted structured-output fallback when the local planning resource is unavailable.
Hosted OrcaRouter structured planning fallback.
Subscription-backed structured planning fallback when local and operator BYOK routes are unavailable.

write.default.description: Natural-prose generation: marketing copy, blog and technical writing, and creative drafts. Local-first, because BYOK local writing is the intended edge; a caller who needs frontier prose quality sets profile REMOTE_ONLY rather than the catalog reordering for everyone.

candidates.reason: Local prose keeps drafts on the host and is the BYOK path a self-hoster gets with no credential.
Hosted fallback where prose quality is the binding constraint; the model stays a resource policy decision.
Hosted OrcaRouter prose fallback.
Subscription-backed metered fallback when local and operator BYOK routes are unavailable.

write.diverse.description: Diversity-controlled prose generation: one request returns k candidate drafts with verbalized hints. Hosted-first, inverting write.default, because diversity gains are emergent with model capability — a small local rung would underperform on the technique this role exists to serve. Candidate count is carried by instruction; the schema subset cannot enforce it.

candidates.reason: A k-candidate response is neither short nor cheap, and diversity gain scales with model capability; this is the rung the technique is designed for.
Hosted OrcaRouter diversity fallback at a different gateway.
Subscription-backed metered fallback, ordered ahead of the local rung because capability matters more than locality for this role specifically.
Local last resort so a host with no credential still gets candidates rather than a failure. Expect measurably lower diversity here; the role's own description says so.

author.generator.description: Long-form code authoring: a parameterized generator program returned as source, validated by the caller before it is ever run. Hosted-first, because the local candidate is sized for short answers and a generator is neither short nor schema-constrained.

candidates.reason: A generator is a program: it must stay internally consistent across a few hundred lines. code.default is the provider's exposed code-authoring role, so the concrete model stays a policy decision rather than a slug in a runtime surface.
Hosted OrcaRouter code-authoring fallback.
Vrooli credits route through the funded LPBS door when the caller selects that source.

Local fallback for a host with no hosted credential. Every authored generator is validated before storage — determinism, declared parameters, no active content, composition at both small and large sizes — so a weaker candidate costs a rejection rather than a bad artifact.

chat.uncensored.description: Explicit-only unrestricted local chat backed by an abliterated model. Callers must name this role deliberately; it is never a default or fallback target, and it has no hosted candidate.

candidates.reason: Local-only by design: unrestricted generation stays on the host and is reachable only through explicit role selection.

research.unrestricted.description: Explicit-only hosted unrestricted research chat. Callers must name this role deliberately; it is never a default or fallback target.

candidates.reason: Abliteration.ai is an explicit research/red-team provider, never a fleet default. Selecting this role is the authorization signal; the credential still gates the call.

research.unrestricted.flash.description: Explicit-only hosted unrestricted research chat with image input and 1M context, served by abliterated-model-large-flash.

candidates.reason: Explicit research/red-team route. Never selected unless the caller names this role.

research.unrestricted.large.description: Explicit-only hosted unrestricted research chat for harder cyber and reasoning work, served by abliterated-model-large-v2. Text only.

candidates.reason: Explicit research/red-team route. Never selected unless the caller names this role.

browser.locate.description: Visual grounding for browser interactions. Accepts a captured browser frame and returns a bounded canonical target; Gateway owns provider selection and credential isolation.

candidates.reason: Local-first grounding keeps captured browser frames on the device.
Hosted multimodal fallback under the caller-selected source and consent.
Hosted grounding fallback under Gateway policy.
Subscription-backed metered grounding; LPBS owns reserve and settlement.

browser.decide.description: Bounded ranking of browser action candidates using the existing fast decision model route.

candidates.reason: Local fast decision route.
Hosted TypeSafe decision route when provisioned.
Hosted TypeSafe decision route when provisioned.
Hosted decision route when provisioned.
Enum-constrained Gateway fallback for choice-only candidate ranking.

browser.plan.description: Produces a bounded browser action plan against the caller-declared world model and schema; Gateway validates the returned structure.

candidates.reason: Use existing local generation with Gateway schema validation.
Hosted structured planning fallback under selected source.
Hosted structured planning fallback under Gateway policy.
LPBS metered structured planning; LPBS owns reserve and settlement.

browser.extract.description: Schema-constrained extraction from supplied browser page content; page text is untrusted input and never becomes provider credentials or browser state.

candidates.reason: Local structured extraction keeps page content on the device; ollama has no extract.structured role, so the local generation role carries the schema.
Hosted extraction fallback under selected source and consent.
Hosted extraction fallback under Gateway policy.
LPBS metered extraction; LPBS owns reserve and settlement.
